description: This file defines the AWS FMS (Firewall Management Service) client class, including documentation annotations for available methods and async variants. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically the FMS client implementation.

classes.name: FMSClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Firewall Management Service (FMS), providing methods to manage policies, resources, and configurations related to firewall management.

methods.name: associateAdminAccount
methods.description: Associates an administrator account with the Firewall Management Service.

methods.name: associateThirdPartyFirewall
methods.description: Associates a third-party firewall with the service.

methods.name: batchAssociateResource
methods.description: Batch associates multiple resources with a firewall policy.

methods.name: batchDisassociateResource
methods.description: Batch disassociates resources from a firewall policy.

methods.name: disassociateAdminAccount
methods.description: Disassociates an administrator account from the Firewall Management Service.

methods.name: getAdminAccount
methods.description: Retrieves details about the administrator account.

methods.name: getComplianceDetail
methods.description: Obtains compliance details for a resource.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves details about a firewall policy.

methods.name: getProtectionStatus
methods.description: Gets the protection status of the firewall.

methods.name: getResourceSet
methods.description: Retrieves details of a resource set.

methods.name: getThirdPartyFirewallAssociationStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a third-party firewall association.

methods.name: listAdminAccountsForOrganization
methods.description: Lists admin accounts for an organization.

methods.name: listResourceSetResources
methods.description: Lists resources within a resource set.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: putAdminAccount
methods.description: Sets or updates an admin account.

methods.name: putAppsList
methods.description: Creates or updates an application list.

methods.name: putNotificationChannel
methods.description: Creates or updates a notification channel.

methods.name: putPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates a firewall policy.

methods.name: putResourceSet
methods.description: Creates or updates a resource set.
